name: io.github.flytomoon/al-buddy-memory
description: Governed local memory for AI agents: facts are retired, not overwritten, and every call is audited.

packageArguments.description: Start the stdio MCP server (the same server as the al-buddy-memory-mcp executable).

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_DB
environmentVariables.description: The SQLite memory file. A leading ~ is expanded.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Whose memory this is; the owner's policy applies to every call.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSONL file for the audit chain instead of the database's own table. One writing process per file.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_AUDIT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HMAC key for the audit chain. Keep it away from the trail.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_SEMANTIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to off for keyword-only recall; the on-device embedding model is then never downloaded.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_MODEL_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Where the on-device embedding model (about 90 MB, downloaded once) is kept.

environmentVariables.name: AL_BUDDY_MEMORY_INDEX_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Most facts embedded in the background per start (0 skips it).
